For the third quarter, the company announced net interest income was USD 3,281 million compared to USD 3,251 million a year ago. Net income was USD 1,908 million compared to USD 1,815 million a year ago. Basic earnings per share was USD 1.16 compared to USD 1.06 a year ago. Diluted earnings per share was USD 1.15 compared to USD 1.06 a year ago. For the nine months, net interest income was USD 9,845 million compared to USD 9,616 million a year ago. Net income was USD 5,428 million compared to USD 5,240 million a year ago. Basic earnings per share was USD 3.26 compared to USD 3.05 a year ago. Diluted earnings per share was USD 3.25 compared to USD 3.04 a year ago.

U.S. Bank Hires Peter Gordon as Head of Emerging Payments Product and Strategy. U.S. Bank hired real-time payments industry veteran Peter Gordon to lead emerging payments efforts across the company. In this new role, Gordon will oversee the strategy and product development of emerging payments products and services at U.S. Bank. Gordon has deep experience in banking and payments and most recently served as chief revenue officer at PayFi. Gordon reports to White and is a part of the U.S. Bank digital leadership team.

U.S. Bank Hires Dr. Tanushree Luke as Head of Artificial Intelligence. U.S. Bank has hired technology leader Dr. Tanushree Luke to lead Artificial Intelligence (AI) efforts at the company. In this role, she will drive the continued development of the AI practice within the U.S. Bank Innovation group and AI strategies across the enterprise. Dr. Luke joins U.S. Bank from Capital One, where she served as the Head of Predictive AI and Machine Learning for Capital One's Conversational AI Platform/Eno.

. Foreside Financial Group, LLC agreed to acquire Quasar Distributors, LLC from U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB).. Foreside Financial Group, LLC agreed to acquire Quasar Distributors, LLC from U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB) on November 25, 2019. The acquisition will expand Foreside’s internal team and client base, with the addition of more than 200 current Quasar clients, 26 employees and a new office location in Milwaukee, WI. Foreside inorganic growth continues to fuel Foreside organic growth, as acquisitions like this one allow it to expand Foreside service offerings and provide better strategic counsel and service to Foreside clients. The transaction is expected to close sometime in the first quarter of 2020.
